## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by using SNIPER-style profit-lock to let winners run while cutting losers short, and by avoiding early morning chop (no_trade_before 09:35) to improve entry quality. The profit-lock arm at +5% with 10% stop offset aims to protect gains during normal retraces, while the high runner target (250%) allows for trend extension.

## Mechanism

Enter on bearish setup with at least 1 trigger (min_triggers_bear=1), no trades before 09:35 ET. Exit logic: TP1 at 30% premium on 50% of position, profit-lock arms at +5% premium with trailing stop offset of 10% (i.e., stop moves to entry × 1.10 when armed), runner target at 250% premium. Strike offset bear=0 (ATM).
